title: Bixx & Christina Novelli - Together Till the End (2026)

lines.l: This world is so silent now
You know we bend but we never break
Shadows are golden hour in our wake
And when the world is all caving in
You'll be the fire underneath my skin
And when the waters don't cave in
You'll be the fire underneath my skin
To get this to the end
To get this to the end
And when the world is all paving in
You'll be the fire underneath my skin
Can I be the sunlight in your eyes
When you need shelter from the rain
